description:
The sibling to our Purple Haze, the Sour Clueless is our most all-road platform designed for long days and multi-surface adventures. All the “go” and none of the bloat, the Clueless is a pared down mile-muncher.

The Clueless is your best friend for long days in the saddle on mixed surfaces. Whether those surfaces are gravel, asphalt, or just the roads between coffee stops, the Clueless is game. Fenders and lights, this bike will take you to the end of the world, or the office before 8am. Knobby tires and fast wheels and you can take on any ridiculous gravel route your chaotic friend has dreamt up.

Steel may be the “original” material to build bikes, but that doesn’t mean it has to be old fashioned. We have all the modern conveniences including internal cable routing, tapered headtube, and a threaded bottom bracket.

Our cable routing jumps out of the frame around the bottom bracket, out of sight, and then continues to the back of the bike externally. Not only does this make service easier, it also saves you a headache or two routing the rear brake and derailleur!

And as you’d expect, the Clueless gets all the smart details to run a rear rack, fenders, all the bottles, and even a fun rack if you purchase the frame with our aluminium adventure fork!

Wheelset built by hand with Duke Worldrunner 25 rims and Duke Bad Boy or Bitex hubs.

Handmade Sour Bicycles CrMo frame featuring heat treated, multi-butted tubing that’s ED-Coated for rust-proofing.

Our dropouts are designed in-house, in Dresden and have a replaceable derailleur hanger.

The seat clamp is designed in-house and is integrated into the frame. Should it ever fail, the frame can be professionally modified to use a traditional clamp.

The perfect fork to pair with a pack-light-travel-fast Sour Clueless build. We love the versatility of our Clueless frames, and this fork is just the cherry on top. Cargo cage mounts for those extra long rides, but minimal enough for all the day-to-day grind. Perfect.

Pictured is a 650b wheel. The fork is designed for 700c but can accept both.

3 Cargo Cage Eyelets on Fork Legs (max. 3.5 kg per side)Flat-mount Brake Mount 140/160mmFender Mounting PossibleWeight With Full Steerer and Axle: ±515g

Below are the frame and fork weights for each size of the Sour Clueless. These weights do not include powdercoating, but please keep in mind that your chosen powdercoat may be heavier than the average coating we use. Fades, gradients, and metallic colours can weigh more than single solid colour powdercoat. If you are interested the final weight, please get in touch. Weights are averaged over three frames per size. We apply an inside wax coating before shipping the frame to your door that will add additional weight.

Included with your Clueless frame or frameset is all the grommets and small parts to run any cabling you wish and a derailleur hanger. You get a rear thru-axle of course, and if you’re ordering a frameset, you get a front axle with your fork as well. Headsets are only included if you add one to your order.

Crankset Rival AXS 172.5mm, 40t Chainring, Incl. Sram bottom bracket
